ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: <image>In $\odot A, m \angle E A D=42$. Find $m \widehat{C B E}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended problem

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a circle with A as the center; point C is on the left side of the circle, point E is on the right side of the circle, and segment CE passes through center A, so C, A, and E are collinear and CE is a diameter. Point B is at the upper left of the circle, and the requested arc \widehat{CBE} is the arc from C to E that passes through B. The central angle \angle EAD=42^\circ is also marked in the figure, but it is located between E and D. Reasoning: Because CE is a diameter, it divides the circle into two semicircles. The arc \widehat{CBE} passing through B is exactly one of the semicircles, so its arc measure is 180^\circ. The given 42^\circ does not need to be used for this solution route.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A is the center of the circle, and C, A, E are collinear with C and E on the circle, so CE is a diameter. The requested arc \(\widehat{CBE}\) is the arc from C to E passing through B, i.e. one of the two semicircles determined by diameter CE. Therefore its measure is \(180^\circ\). The given \(m\angle EAD=42\) is not needed for this route.

method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that both CE and BD pass through center A, so they are diameters. From the text, \(m\angle EAD=42^\circ\), so the minor arc \(\widehat{ED}\) is \(42^\circ\). Since BD is a diameter, the semicircle \(\widehat{BED}\) measures \(180^\circ\), so \(m\widehat{BE}=180-42=138^\circ\). Also, \(\angle CAB\) is vertical to \(\angle EAD\), so \(m\angle CAB=42^\circ\), giving \(m\widehat{CB}=42^\circ\). Then \(m\widehat{CBE}=m\widehat{CB}+m\widehat{BE}=42+138=180^\circ\).
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中是以 A 为圆心的圆，B 在左上方，C 在左侧，E 在右侧，D 在右下方。线段 CE 经过圆心 A，线段 BD 也经过圆心 A；角 EAD 在图中标为 42°。再推理：因为 CE 和 BD 都经过圆心且端点在圆上，所以它们都是直径。由中心角等于所对小弧的度数，∠EAD = 42°，所以小弧 ED = 42°。因为 BD 是直径，弧 BED 是半圆，度数为 180°，所以弧 BE = 180° - 42° = 138°。又因为 ∠CAB 与 ∠EAD 是对顶角，所以 ∠CAB = 42°，从而弧 CB = 42°。因此弧 CBE = 弧 CB + 弧 BE = 42° + 138° = 180°。
